verdict: THE CURATED DIRECTED NETWORK. Dropping the transcription-factor heuristic -- 23,097 edges that no curated source could check even in principle -- leaves 8,897 PPI edges (4.65%) with an arrow that traces to a database record, plus 507 recorded as FEEDBACK pairs. Four curated sources contribute: SIGNOR signalling, Reactome reaction order, Reactome PREPARATION (output of one reaction feeding the input of another -- the step that supplies a pathway with the protein its first reaction consumes), and curated TF->target regulation. OF THOSE, 1,777 ARE CONFIRMED BY TWO OR MORE INDEPENDENT SOURCES (0.93% of the interactome) and 7,120 rest on one source alone. A further 23,725 edges are touched by a source that contradicts ITSELF -- Reactome records both A-before-B and B-before-A for them -- and get no arrow; an earlier version dropped those silently and lost them from the accounting entirely. BUT CORROBORATION WAS NOT SHOWN TO BUY CONFIDENCE, and this is the result that should temper the whole exercise. Leave-one-source-out -- hold a source out of the confirmation, then check the arrow against it -- gives CONFIRMED 0.501 and SINGLE 0.523, both essentially at the 0.500 chance line, with CONFIRMED ahead in 1 of 2 tests. The samples are small (n=86 and n=48) and their intervals straddle chance, so the honest reading is UNDERPOWERED rather than refuted; and the only sources with enough held-out overlap to test are the two Reactome-derived ones, which are the weakest of the four. What it does mean is that 'CONFIRMED' here records agreement between two sources, and must NOT be read as a demonstrated accuracy. THE FEEDBACK TIER IS NOT A FAILURE AND IS THE REASON THIS IS TIERED AT ALL. 507 edges have two curated sources pointing OPPOSITE ways, and the audit showed 98% of such conflicts involve a transcription factor: a kinase acts on a TF while that TF regulates the kinase's gene. Both arrows are real. Forcing one would have destroyed information and inflated the apparent coverage, so both are kept with their relation types. WHAT THIS CANNOT SAY. Curated does not mean true in K562 -- Reactome and SIGNOR describe canonical human biology, not this cell line under these conditions. 'Reactome-prepares' is the weakest of the four: sharing an entity means one reaction CAN supply another, not that it does, and the currency-molecule cap is blunt enough to drop informative hubs like ubiquitin along with ATP. A precedence relation between reactions still does not prove the two PROTEINS touch in that order. And coverage is the price of this honesty: 83% of the interactome has no curated arrow at all.
